sanitizers.precondition: element with at least one isotope of abundance > 0
sanitizers.invariant: natural abundances (percent) sum to 100
sanitizers.rationale: isotope-pattern and mass calculations assume a normalized composition

sanitizers.invariant: abundance-weighted mean isotope mass equals the tabulated atomic weight
sanitizers.rationale: molecular weights use the tabulated atomic weight

sanitizers.invariant: nuclear binding energy per nucleon is below 9 MeV so abs(m - A) <= 0.01 A
sanitizers.rationale: an isotope mass far from its mass number is a transcription error

sanitizers.scientific_quantity: van der Waals and covalent radius
sanitizers.invariant: the van der Waals radius exceeds the covalent radius
sanitizers.rationale: steric and surface descriptors assume nonbonded contact distance exceeds bond distance

sanitizers.precondition: element with known abundances and a most-common-isotope entry
sanitizers.invariant: the most common isotope has maximal abundance and the tabulated exact mass equals that isotope's mass
sanitizers.alarm: abundance of the entry below the maximum, entry absent, or mass differs by more than 1e-6
sanitizers.rationale: exact-mass calculations read this entry

sanitizers.precondition: a call that finishes the iteration with all atom parameters resolved
sanitizers.invariant: charge equalization only moves charge: heavy-atom plus implicit-hydrogen charges sum to the total after the initial conjugated split of formal charge
sanitizers.observation_point: after the iteration loop, before the charges are stored
sanitizers.alarm: abs(sum_end - sum_start) > 64 eps (N+1)(nIter+1) max(1, max abs q)
sanitizers.rationale: partial charges feed electrostatics and QSAR descriptors; non-conservation creates or destroys charge

sanitizers.precondition: 3D force field, no fixed points, no position-constraint contribution, at most 500 points (every gradient call), and no two points closer than 0.01 A (angle/inversion terms regularise there)
sanitizers.invariant: an energy built from internal coordinates is translation invariant so the gradient sums to zero
sanitizers.observation_point: after all contributions have been accumulated (re-accumulated on a private buffer)
sanitizers.alarm: norm(sum g) > 1e-9 * sum over contributions and points of |g|
sanitizers.rationale: a nonzero net force makes a minimizer drift

sanitizers.invariant: rotation invariance gives zero net torque about the centroid
sanitizers.alarm: norm(sum (r_i - c) x g_i) > 1e-9 * sum |r_i - c||g_i|
sanitizers.rationale: a nonzero torque means the energy changes under rigid rotation of an isolated molecule

sanitizers.precondition: any minimization with at least one contribution
sanitizers.invariant: minimization does not end above its starting energy
sanitizers.observation_point: end of minimize, energy re-summed from the contributions
sanitizers.alarm: E_final > E_initial + 1e3 eps max(1, abs E_initial)
sanitizers.rationale: a minimized conformer must not be worse than the start

sanitizers.invariant: upper bounds obey the triangle inequality U(i,j) <= U(i,k) + U(k,j)
sanitizers.alarm: any triple exceeds by more than 8 eps maxU + tol maxU
sanitizers.rationale: a bounds matrix violating the metric axioms cannot be realized in 3D

sanitizers.invariant: lower bounds obey L(i,j) >= L(i,k) - U(k,j)
sanitizers.alarm: any triple violates by more than the same slack
sanitizers.rationale: same

sanitizers.invariant: after smoothing every pair has L(i,j) <= U(i,j)
sanitizers.alarm: L > U + slack for any pair
sanitizers.rationale: an empty interval means no geometry satisfies the pair

sanitizers.invariant: moments are nonnegative and satisfy the rigid-body triangle inequality I_a + I_b >= I_c
sanitizers.alarm: a moment below -64 eps Imax or any inequality violated by more than 64 eps Imax
sanitizers.rationale: a mass distribution has a physically realizable inertia tensor

sanitizers.invariant: the principal axes form an orthonormal basis
sanitizers.rationale: axes are the basis into which conformers are canonicalized

sanitizers.precondition: at least 2 atoms entering the sums
sanitizers.invariant: about the origin the second-moment matrix is diagonal with descending entries
sanitizers.alarm: off-diagonal > 1e3 eps scale or diagonal not descending beyond that
sanitizers.rationale: canonical orientation is used for alignment-free shape comparison

sanitizers.precondition: center argument absent, at least 2 atoms
sanitizers.invariant: the centroid is at the origin after canonicalization
sanitizers.rationale: translation to the center is the first step of the canonical transform

sanitizers.invariant: NPR1 <= NPR2 <= 1 and NPR1 + NPR2 >= 1
sanitizers.alarm: any inequality violated by more than 64 eps
sanitizers.rationale: the NPR1/NPR2 shape map is a triangle for any rigid body

sanitizers.invariant: the 3x3 block is orthogonal with determinant +1 unless reflection was requested
sanitizers.alarm: max abs(R^T R - I) > 1e-9, abs(abs det - 1) > 1e-9, or det < 0 with reflect false
sanitizers.rationale: alignment must not distort the molecule or invert its chirality unless asked

sanitizers.invariant: reported mean squared deviation equals the one recomputed after applying the transform
sanitizers.rationale: RMSD is the headline similarity score

sanitizers.precondition: no weights, no reflection, eigen-solver iteration cap at least the default 50
sanitizers.invariant: no fixed-seed small rotation of the aligned probe lowers the msd
sanitizers.alarm: a rotated msd below the aligned msd by more than the tolerance of RDK-AL-002
sanitizers.rationale: a better rigid motion exists so the alignment is not optimal

sanitizers.invariant: making hydrogens explicit conserves composition (implicit hydrogens counted) and net charge
sanitizers.rationale: formula, mass and charge are independent of hydrogen representation

sanitizers.precondition: sanitize true, caches valid; every explicit H is uncharged and hangs on an atom that can absorb it (no isolated H, H ion, H2, H on a dummy)
sanitizers.invariant: removing explicit hydrogens conserves composition and net charge
sanitizers.observation_point: scope exit of removeHs (after the cache refresh)
sanitizers.rationale: same

sanitizers.invariant: valence-form normalization conserves net charge and per-element atom counts (explicit atoms)
sanitizers.rationale: the same compound keeps charge and formula in any resonance form

sanitizers.invariant: each atom's bond-valence sum after kekulization equals its explicit valence before
sanitizers.rationale: kekulization chooses a localization; it must not change valence

sanitizers.invariant: the number of SSSR rings equals bonds - atoms + components (dative / hydrogen bonds per the flags; zero-order bonds are ignored by ring perception)
sanitizers.rationale: ring count is the cyclomatic number

sanitizers.invariant: each ring is a simple cycle of bonded atoms
sanitizers.alarm: a ring with repeated atoms or non-bonded neighbours
sanitizers.rationale: ring lists feed aromaticity and ring-fusion logic

sanitizers.precondition: every transform template has equal element counts and net charge on both sides; caches valid
sanitizers.invariant: normalization rewrites resonance forms and conserves composition and charge
sanitizers.rationale: normalization yields the same compound

sanitizers.precondition: caches valid; no isolated neutral Li/Na/K/Mg/Ca/Cl atom (charge corrections charge those by design)
sanitizers.invariant: protons move between sites; composition and net charge conserved
sanitizers.rationale: same compound, different ionization

sanitizers.invariant: each neutralization moves one proton: heavy composition and net charge minus total H count are conserved
sanitizers.rationale: proton and electron bookkeeping of acid/base neutralization

sanitizers.invariant: every tautomer has the input's composition and net charge
sanitizers.rationale: tautomers are isomers

sanitizers.invariant: the canonical tautomer has the input's composition and net charge
sanitizers.rationale: same

sanitizers.invariant: bond cleavage redistributes charge but conserves atoms (implicit H not counted) and net charge
sanitizers.rationale: atoms and electrons are conserved

sanitizers.precondition: every template atom mapped one-to-one with equal element and charge; each reactant a single fragment; product sets that copy a reactant atom into several products (cleaved ring bond) are skipped
sanitizers.invariant: each product set has the heavy-atom element counts and net charge of its reactants
sanitizers.rationale: a balanced transformation conserves atoms and charge

sanitizers.invariant: stereoisomers share atoms, charges, bonds, bond orders and composition
sanitizers.rationale: stereoisomers differ only in spatial arrangement

sanitizers.precondition: canonical output, no query atoms or bonds, no dative / hydrogen bonds, at most 100 atoms
sanitizers.invariant: the SMILES parses back to the same atom count, bond count, composition and net charge
sanitizers.rationale: serialization must not change the compound

sanitizers.invariant: canonical SMILES does not depend on atom order (fixed-seed permutation, exact transform)
sanitizers.rationale: canonical form is the basis of deduplication
